categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic endoscopy equipment and endoscopic diagnostic and surgical consumables. Its products serve multiple clinical departments including gastroenterology, respiratory, ENT, gynecology, and emergency medicine. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in R&D, manufacturing, and marketing of endoscopy-related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as endoscopic image processing, endoscope body design and integration, and electrical isolation technology. It has developed advanced 4K ultra-high-definition endoscopy systems, spectral imaging, dual-focus endoscopes, and microscopic endoscopes with magnifications up to 640x. Production strictly follows medical device regulations and quality management systems ISO13485 and ISO9001, with rigorous quality control at procurement, manufacturing, and final inspection stages.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are hospitals and medical institutions, including tertiary hospitals and county-level medical facilities. The company serves domestic and international markets, with products used in clinical diagnosis and treatment of digestive, respiratory, urinary, and other diseases. Overseas markets include Germany, the UK, South Korea, and other developed countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with expanding overseas presence in Europe (Germany, UK), Asia (South Korea), and other countries along the Belt and Road initiative. It has established marketing and service centers in multiple countries and regions, and subsidiaries in Ireland, Hong Kong, Russia, and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, encompassing R&D, manufacturing of endoscopy equipment and consumables, and direct sales or distribution to hospitals and medical institutions. It controls the full process from product development to after-sales service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ultra-high-definition imaging, spectral imaging, AI-assisted diagnostics, and endoscopic robotics. It invests heavily in R&D (over 21% of revenue), focusing on clinical needs and future trends such as automated operation, intelligent diagnosis, and precision treatment. The company also emphasizes expanding global market access and accelerating import substitution of foreign brands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of endoscopy equipment, diagnostic and surgical consumables, and maintenance services. Sales channels include direct sales to medical institutions and distribution via dealers. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Japanese firms such as Olympus, Fujifilm, and Pentax Medical, which dominate the global soft endoscopy market. Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with competitive technology and growing market share, especially in high-end 4K endoscopy systems, aiming to break foreign monopolies and lead import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 749.5 million, a 10.54% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21 million, down 63.68% due to increased expenses and stock incentive adjustments. Total assets grew 9.63% to RMB 1.75 billion, with equity around RMB 1.37 billion. The company maintains strong R&D investment and is in a growth and expansion phase.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy emphasizes high-definition imaging quality, advanced spectral and dual-focus technologies, and comprehensive clinical applicability across multiple specialties. Its products offer enhanced diagnostic accuracy and treatment efficiency, supported by strong R&D capabilities and quality control. The company also highlights its growing global footprint, localized service networks, and commitment to import substitution as key differentiators.
